{{Quote|He'll do well, I think.''"<br />"''He'll die.|Ori and Candra Kitai discussing Campion's skills as an uvak wrangler|<ref name="Purgatory" />}}
'''Campion Dey''' was an [[uvak wrangler]] from the southlands of [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]], a continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. He was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who were a group of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] that had become stranded on Kesh during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. In [[3960 BBY]], he represented the Kitai family during a [[rake-riding]] event that took place in the stadium [[Korsinata]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tahv]]. During the event, Dey [[Assassination attempt in the Korsinata|attempted to assassinate]] [[Lillia Venn]], the [[Grand Lord]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], but his attack failed and he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] seconds afterwards by the Luzo brothers [[Flen Luzo|Flen]] and [[Sawj Luzo|Sawj]]. In reality, this assassination attempt had been staged by Grand Lord Lillia as an opportunity to eliminate her political opponents and to strengthen her own political position by promoting her supporters to the [[Circle of Lords]]. Dey's actions triggered a chain reaction of events which led to the exposure of the secret [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jelph Marrian]] and his [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|starship]], the demise of Grand Lord Venn, and ushered in [[Time of the Rot|the Time of the Rot]], a millennium of anarchy and chaos in the Tribe's history.

==Biography==
===Rake-Riding===
{{Quote|We're going to have to win sometime.''"<br />"''Not today.|Ori and Candra watching Campion Dey during his last rake-riding game|<ref name="Purgatory" />}}
Campion Dey grew up more than a millennium after the ancestors of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Yaru Korsin]] had subjugated the native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] living on [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]], a continent in the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] southern hemisphere.<ref name="Secrets">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Secrets]]''</ref> Campion was an [[uvak wrangler]] who specialized in [[rake-riding]], a violent blood sports which pitted flightless [[uvak]], reptilian beasts, and their riders against each other. Uvak used in rake-riding had their wing muscles cut at birth, keeping them permanently grounded. He came from the southlands of the continent and lived near [[Starfall (Kesh)|Starfall]], which was also the home of his sponsors [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Candra Kitai]] and her daughter [[Sith Saber]] [[Orielle Kitai]]. He developed a close relationship with the Kitais who sponsored his training and dotted on him. While Campion was competent, he was not regarded as being one of the best rake-riders.<ref name="Purgatory" />

In [[3960 BBY]], Campion participated in the [[Donellan's Day]] rake-riding games, which were attended by several prominent Sith citizens including the reigning Grand Lord [[Lillia Venn]], Candra, Orielle, and [[Dernas]] and [[Pallima]], the latter being the leaders of the [[Red Faction|Red]] and [[Gold Faction]]s. While the Grand Lord and her allies, the two Luzo brothers [[Flen Luzo|Flen]] and [[Sawj Luzo]], sponsored two uvak-wranglers, the Kitais only had one entry: Campion. These sporting events were considered to be succession struggles between the rival Sith factions. During the games, the Kitais speculated that Campion did not have a good chance of winning since he was competing against more aggressive and experienced riders. Following the start of the game, Campion and his uvak unexpectedly disengaged from the fray.<ref name="Purgatory" />

Campion then somehow got his uvak steed to leap and fly towards the grandstands. Standing in his saddle, Campion raised his [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]] and shouted something indecipherable to the crowd. Campion's actions caused much panic and confusion among the Sith and Keshiri spectators. Campion then set the uvak on a gallop towards the Grand Lord's royal box in the grandstand, injuring several spectators in the process. However, Grand Lord Venn used [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] to kill Campion's uvak, causing the animal and its rider to fall backward onto the lower seating. Venn's bodyguards Flen and Sawj then descended on the wounded Campion and finished him off with their lightsabers. Campion's actions horrified his sponsors, the Kitai family, who had not staged an assassination attempt on the Grand Lord and were bewildered by his rash actions.<ref name="Purgatory" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|What happened, Mother?''"<br />"''You...you'd better go, Ori.|Ori and Candra responding to Campion's failed assassination attempt against Grand Lord Venn|<ref name="Purgatory" />}}
Campion Dey's actions set a chain reaction of events that would alter the course of the Tribe's history. In reality, this assassination attempt had been staged by Grand Lord Lillia as an opportunity to eliminate her political opponents and to strengthen her own political position by promoting her supporters to the [[Circle of Lords]]. Firstly, his sponsors, the Kitai family, were reduced to the status of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and were stripped of all their former titles, lands, and possessions. His main sponsor, the High Lord Candra Kitai, was coerced into confessing that she had conspired with Dernas and Pallima, the leaders of the Red and Gold Faction, to assassinate Lillia. While the Grand Lord Lillia spared her life, she made a public example of Candra by forcing her to shovel manure in public. Secondly, this political downfall motivated Candra's daughter Orielle Kitai to find a means of restoring her family's status. An opportunity to do so materialized when Orielle discovered that her friend [[Jelph Marrian]] was actually an offworld [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|starship]], a "Kesh-shaking" technology that would allow the Tribe to return to the [[Star/Legends|stars]].<ref name="Purgatory" />

Thirdly, Lillia learnt about Orielle's discovery after the latter's mother betrayed her daughter and sold the information to the Grand Lord in return for "improved working conditions." Seeking to further her ambitions, Lillia traveled to [[Jelph Marrian's farm]] where she attempted to seize the starship. However, it had been rigged to an ingenious "anti-theft system", which destroyed the vehicle, its occupant, and Lillia's followers during a violent conflagration. Thus, Dey's actions brought about the demise of Grand Lord Lillia, which would have profound consequences for the successive centuries. Finally, the "disappearance" of Lillia during the so-called [[Night of the Upside-Down Meteor]] created an [[Time of the Rot|internal power struggle]] that would last for almost a millennium. This conflict devastated much of Keshtah until the [[Caretaker]] [[Varner Hilts]] succeeded in ending this conflict and reuniting the Tribe in [[3000 BBY]].<ref name="Sentinel">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Campion Dey was a skilled uvak wrangler who rode flightless uvak that were used in rake-riding, one of the most violent blood sports on Sith-dominated Kesh. As a member of the Lost Tribe, he was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and also knew how to use a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. He developed a close friendship with his sponsors Lady Candra Kitai and her daughter Orielle Kitai. However, he kept one secret from them: his plan to murder the reigning [[Grand Lord]] Lillia Venn. This mad and reckless action led to his death and brought about the downfall of his sponsors.<ref name="Purgatory" />

==Behind the scenes==
Campion Dey appeared as a minor supporting and non-point-of-view character in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Purgatory]]'', which was released on [[October 25]], [[2010]]. This marks his only known appearance in the [[Star Wars]] [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]]. According to an email from Miller dated to [[January 22]] [[2014]], Campion was either set up by Lillia Venn's agents into making a lone-wolf attack on the Grand Lord herself or was flipped by Venn's camp into staging at attack only to find out to his surprise that he had to die in the process.<ref name="JJM Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:John Jackson Miller email 22 January 2014.jpg|creator=[[John Jackson Miller]]|date=2014-01-22}}</ref>
